title: Dust Bunnies, Meet Your Doom
tagline: Perfect for the DIYer who’s tired of their cat judging their workshop cleanup. This cordless vacuum won’t just suck up sawdust—it’ll also hoover up your excuses for not finishing that shelving project. Plus, it’s quiet enough to use while your neighbor’s kid is napping, so you can finally clean up that garage without getting a noise complaint.

title: Gothic Light Fixture for the Macabre Minimalist
tagline: Because your 'dark academia' aesthetic needs more than just a black coffee mug. This skull sconce is perfect for when you want to read 'Dracula' by the light of a single candle, but also need to charge your phone. Ideal for the person who's one step away from turning their living room into a haunted mansion.

title: Rainbow Rim Jobs
tagline: For when your margarita needs to match your mood ring. Perfect for that one friend who insists their tequila sunset is 'more of a lavender moment.' Comes in six colors, because why settle for boring salt when you can have a full spectrum of sodium? Just don't ask what gives it that neon hue.

title: Dungeon Suds: Roll for Cleanliness
tagline: For when your LARPing group's 'medieval hygiene' policy is more suggestion than rule. This soap is perfect for the rogue who wants to wash away the day's dragon blood without breaking character. Just don't blame us if your DM rules that a nat 1 means you drop the soap.

title: Shark Infested Drinks
tagline: Because your whiskey wasn't menacing enough, add a 3D shark ice cube to give your guests a fin-tastic fright. Ideal for that one dinner party where you want to subtly hint it's time to leave.

title: Technicolor Sugar Shock
tagline: For when your 'adult' dinner party needs a neon sugar rush. These aren't just treats, they're a full sensory experience—like eating a unicorn's vomit, but in the best possible way. Perfect for that one friend who insists on serving 'artisanal' charcuterie but secretly craves the joy of a middle school bake sale.

title: Bedtime Astronomy for Insomniacs
tagline: Because staring at your ceiling isn't weird enough, now you can project the cosmos onto it. Perfect for when you're trying to explain the Big Bang to your cat at 3 AM, or when your significant other asks why you're still awake and you need to justify your late-night hobby of amateur astronomy from the comfort of your bed.

title: Socks for Beer Snobs
tagline: For when you're drinking alone and want your feet to know it's a craft brew, these beer mug socks are a sole-ful companion.

title: Sloth Jewelry for Slowpokes
tagline: Because who needs to rush when you can accessorize with a miniature sloth? Perfect for that friend who takes 45 minutes to order coffee—now they can match their pace with a felt sloth dangling from their earlobe. Bonus: It’s the only pet you won’t have to feed or walk.

title: Bargain Bin Cosplay
tagline: Ever wanted to dress as a contestant on *The Price Is Right* for Halloween? Now you can—just don’t expect to win a new car. Perfect for that office party where the prize is a fruitcake and a pat on the back. Comes with a giant wheel of shame and a 'I’m a Plinko loser' vibe. Bonus: It’s the only costume where yelling 'Come on down!' is mandatory.

title: Link’s Retirement Sword
tagline: For when your mid-life crisis involves slaying a few Ganon-shaped regrets. This isn’t just a prop—it’s a conversation starter at your next Dungeon Master’s potluck. Perfect for when you’re ‘just testing its sharpness’ on that overripe pumpkin in your backyard. Hyrule’s finest craftsmanship, now collecting dust in your man cave.

title: Sniff Test for the Lazy
tagline: For those moments when your nose fails you—like when you find a mystery container in the back of the fridge that could be either yogurt or a science experiment. This gadget takes the guesswork out of 'Is this still good?' with a level of precision that's either impressive or deeply unnecessary. Perfect for roommates who argue over expired mayo.

title: Stuffed Soulmates for the Lonely
tagline: For those nights when your cat's judgmental stare is too much, but a human relationship feels like too much work. These aren't just stuffed animals—they're your emotional support system with a side of taxidermy vibes. Perfect for explaining to your therapist why you have a conversation with a plush fox named Reginald.

title: May The Vow Be
tagline: For the couple who's love is stronger than the Death Star, but not stronger than their nerdiness. Imagine exchanging these Star Wars wedding rings at a themed wedding, surrounded by Wookiees and Ewoks, and wondering if your love will last longer than the Empire.

title: Shredding on a Keyboard
tagline: For the guitarist who’s tired of being the only one at the party who can’t play ‘Smoke on the Water’ on a keyboard. These guitar-shaped keys let you pretend you’re rocking out on a Gibson while actually just typing out your TPS reports. Perfect for when your bandmates are out of town and you still need to feel like a rockstar.

title: Great Scott! It's a Truck!
tagline: For when you need to explain 1985 American vehicular aesthetics to someone from, say, 1955. Or 2015. Miniature version, of course. No DeLorean included, so you'll have to find your own flux capacitor if you're planning any serious temporal shenanigans. Just saying, it exists.

title: Boozy Bullet Glass
tagline: For when you want to toast your questionable life choices, this revolver shot glass is oddly fitting. Like, it's 3 AM and you're contemplating a tattoo – this glass gets it.

title: David Controls Your Illumination?
tagline: For the classicist who's also incredibly lazy. Why fumble for a switch like some common Philistine when you can simply... touch David's divine posterior? Perfect for illuminating your dungeon—I mean, home library—with a flick of a marble-smooth buttock.

title: Rolling Into Regret, Fast
tagline: Tired of the tyranny of inline skates? Embrace the chaos. These circular skates promise a truly unique… experience. Perfect for that one friend who insists on 'reinventing' the grocery run, or perhaps a spontaneous interpretive dance piece on freshly-mowed grass. Just try to avoid hills. Seriously.

title: Muggle-Proof Your Kindle
tagline: For those nights when you're reading 'Pride and Prejudice' but wish you were casting 'Wingardium Leviosa' on your cat. This case turns your Kindle into a Hogwarts library book, complete with spell-tastic graphics. Perfect for when your roommate asks why you're muttering 'Lumos' at your e-reader.

title: Punch a Bear in the Face Gloves
tagline: For the 'I can take it' crowd who also enjoys a side of 'I can dish it out.' Perfect for when you accidentally grab a hot pan, or when you're *accidentally* in a bar fight. The Kevlar weave ensures your knuckles stay intact, even if your dignity doesn't.

title: Carbonite Cocktail Cubes
tagline: When you want to serve drinks to your nerdy friends, but also imprison their favorite smuggler, this ice tray is the answer. Han Solo's frozen face will chill your whiskey, and your friendships.

title: Game Boy Mug: Liquid Pause
tagline: For when you need to hit the 'start' button on your caffeine intake. Perfect for retro gamers who still think 'Game Over' means it's time for a coffee break. This mug is the only way to justify drinking coffee while pretending to play Tetris on your phone during a boring meeting.

title: Germs, Meet Your Copper Nemesis
tagline: For the office hypochondriac who’s convinced their desk is a petri dish, this copper sphere is like a tiny, shiny bouncer. Place it on your keyboard and watch it silently judge your coworkers’ hygiene while passively sterilizing your workspace. Just don’t blame it when your desk becomes the loneliest spot in the office.

title: Feline Lazy Lounge
tagline: For the cat that's judged you harshly from the couch, now they can do it from a hammock. Because what they really needed was a better view of your failures.

title: Nap-Time Princess Power
tagline: For the kid who insists on dramatic exits from bedtime. Perfect for parents who’ve given up on pajamas and now just need to bribe their toddler into sleep with the promise of a crown. Comes with a ‘Do Not Disturb’ tiara—because even princesses need their beauty rest.

title: The Lid That Judges Your Leftovers
tagline: Ever stare into the abyss of your fridge, holding a Tupperware with no lid, wondering if it’s worth transferring to a new container? This is the lid that says, 'Yes, you should’ve just eaten it last night.' Fits most containers, but not your excuses. Perfect for the person who’s one mismatched lid away from a full existential crisis.

title: Sword for Your Cat’s Birthday
tagline: When your feline turns 10, and you realize you’ve spent more on their toys than your own hobbies, this handmade Japanese sword is the perfect ‘I’m sorry I forgot your birthday’ gift. Just imagine their little paws trying to bat at it—bonus points if they knock it over and you have to explain to the paramedics why your living room looks like a samurai training ground.

title: Glowing Skateboard Shame
tagline: For when you need to illuminate your midnight solo skate sessions in an abandoned parking lot, these underglow LED lights will make your skateboard glow, and your loneliness slightly more bearable.

title: Undead Road Trip Crew
tagline: Because nothing says 'family vacation' like a minivan full of brain-craving zombies. Perfect for when you want to subtly warn other drivers that your backseat is basically a horror movie set. Bonus: If you get pulled over, the cop will probably just speed away in terror.

title: Jedi Parking Valet
tagline: Tired of your lightsaber rolling off the coffee table during your 'I am your father' monologues? This stand is the droid you're looking for. Perfect for the Sith Lord who wants to keep their weapon of mass destruction within arm's reach while they're busy force-choking their cat.

title: Slither Into Style
tagline: For when your board meeting needs a little more 'hiss'. Perfect for the CEO who wants to subtly remind employees they're in a cutthroat environment. Bonus points if you pair it with a lizard-print belt. Just don't blame us if HR gets suspicious.

title: The Invisible Shield
tagline: For those who’ve ever been mid-conversation when a sudden whiff of yesterday’s lunch wafts through the room, this is your knight in odor-resistant armor. Perfect for the office hero who just microwaved fish sticks, or the gym rat who forgot deodorant—again. It’s not magic, but it’s close enough to make your coworkers question their sanity.

title: Ice Cubes with a PhD
tagline: For the home mixologist who’s tired of their whiskey looking like it’s been through a snowstorm. This tray crafts crystal-clear cubes so pristine, your guests will accuse you of buying them from a lab. Perfect for that one friend who insists on serving ‘artisanal’ ice in their $15 margarita.

title: Pants? Shirt? Why Not Both?
tagline: For those days when you can't decide between casual and professional, this hybrid garment has you covered—literally. Perfect for the over-caffeinated barista who needs to transition from morning espresso rush to afternoon poetry reading without changing. Just zip up the shirt part when your boss walks in. Fashion forward? More like fashion confused.

title: Titanium Belt for Overpackers
tagline: For the person who carries a Swiss Army knife, three phones, and a mini first-aid kit in their pockets—yet still needs a belt that won’t snap under the weight of their tactical wallet. This titanium beast won’t just hold up your pants; it’ll hold up your entire EDC (Everyday Carry) lifestyle. Perfect for the survivalist who’s more likely to be stranded in a mall than the wilderness.

title: Nerdy Keyboard Camo
tagline: For when you need to type out your thesis on Batman's moral ambiguity but also want to subtly signal your allegiance to the Dark Knight. Perfect for that late-night coffee shop study session where you're *totally* not avoiding your roommate's cat.

title: Wine Excuse Generator
tagline: For when you need a fancy reason to drink alone on Tuesdays, this label has got you covered with vague, sophisticated-sounding excuses.

title: Doormat for the Hip-Hop Historian
tagline: For when your home is so fresh, it needs a doormat with a 2000s slang refresher. Perfect for the basement apartment where your roommate still thinks 'fo shizzle' is peak humor. Now you can finally welcome guests with the same linguistic flair as a 2003 rap mixtape.

title: Lawn Envy, iPhone Edition
tagline: Tired of your phone blending into the abyss of your pocket? Now you can lose it in a patch of grass instead. Perfect for the urban gardener who wants to feel connected to nature—while still being able to check their email. Bonus: Confuses cats and makes your phone calls sound like you're in a meadow.

title: Lamp for Your Black Hole
tagline: Because your dorm room needs a void, this lamp creates a nebula effect, perfect for when you're trying to impress your astronomy club friends or just want to simulate a black hole on your desk.

title: High on Life, Low on Patience
tagline: For the botanist who forgot to water their plants because they were too busy forgetting they had plants. These pots come with built-in reminders—just don’t blame them if your succulents still end up as dried-up memories of your last sober thought.

title: Stoner’s Crystal Ball
tagline: For the mystic who prefers their divination with a side of smoke. Perfect for the midnight seance where the spirits demand a contact high. Just don’t blame us if your tarot cards start predicting a ‘very chill’ future.

title: D&D for the Lazy Mage
tagline: For when your Dungeon Master insists on 'immersive storytelling' but you’d rather not lift a finger. These pre-made spellbook boxes let you pretend you spent hours crafting your character’s backstory. Perfect for the player who wants to feel prepared without, you know, actually preparing. Just open the box and hope no one asks how you got that +3 to Charisma.

title: Wine Bottle’s Second Act
tagline: For the person who insists their empty wine bottles are 'still useful,' here’s your chance to prove it. Perfect for the post-party cleanup where you realize you’ve got more bottles than sense. Now you can light up your ‘I’ll recycle tomorrow’ pile in style. Just don’t blame us if your guests mistake it for a fancy candle holder and try to drink it.

title: Pixel Picked Flowers
tagline: For the lovebird who's also a gamer, this 8-bit flower bouquet is perfect for apologizing after a 12-hour gaming binge, when actual flowers just won't cut it.

title: Gills for the Commitment-Phobic
tagline: For those who can't decide between a snorkel and a full SCUBA rig, this hybrid is the aquatic equivalent of a 'maybe' relationship. Perfect for the traveler who wants to dip a toe in deep-sea exploration but still needs to surface for a cocktail. Just don't ask it to commit to one depth.

title: Turtle Power, Wrist Edition
tagline: For when you need to escape a windowless van, but also want to subtly remind your captors that you’re a 90s kid. These paracord bracelets come in TMNT colors, so you can channel your inner ninja while untying your zip ties. Perfect for survivalists who still think April O’Neil is the coolest journalist ever.

title: Waffle Menagerie Madness
tagline: Because your brunch needed a lion-shaped waffle, this gadget is perfect for the Sunday morning when you're hungover and trying to impress your niece with 'fun aunt' credentials.

title: Dice That Judge You
tagline: For when you need your D&D dice to flash shamefully after a critical fail, reminding you of that one time you rolled a 1 in front of your friends.
